KNOWN BUG (flag for backend team): Two compounding issues make this endpoint non-functional. (1) The spec marks POST /auth/refresh as bearerAuth-secured, so AuthMiddleware runs and rejects any non-access token type with 401 'invalid token type' — a refresh token can never pass. (2) Even if the security spec were fixed, the handler reads the Bearer token via c.GetString(BearerAuthScopes) but oapi-codegen stores []string{} (not the raw token) at that key, so the value is always empty string → handler returns 401. Fix: remove bearerAuth from the /auth/refresh spec entry AND rewrite the handler to read Authorization header directly.
